MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable partly fits because I have bought a display cable before, so connecting a display is a familiar purpose, although I do not need HDMI today.",
    "The cable ties relate to the adapters and cables I use and could be useful during a cleanup, but I have no current project that calls for a 100-pack."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The CPU cooler and case fan assume I want to work on cooling, while my purchases show specific connection needs rather than an ongoing computer upgrade.",
    "The hard drives, SATA cable and drive mounting kit depend on a storage project I have not indicated; having USB ports does not make an external drive useful to me right now.",
    "Buying a tablet mount does not establish that I need a memory card, and nothing in my recent purchases suggests I need a replacement mouse."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My desktop USB expansion card seems to have been taken as interest in many kinds of internal computer parts.",
    "Shared words such as USB, cable and tablet seem to matter more than whether an item solves the same practical problem."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase addressed wired network connectivity, which is a more specific need than general computer accessories.",
    "My purchases are spaced far apart and serve distinct purposes; an older purchase does not mean I am still working on that setup.",
    "I rarely buy without a concrete need, so even a related accessory needs a clear use and the right connection or compatibility to interest me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical connectivity accessories but stretched it into upgrade and storage needs that my history does not establish."
}
